<awtsmoosMeluketTranslation heichel="ikar" alias="meluket_translation_en" seriesId="שבט_meluket" postId="BH_POST_1766518916678_theRebbe_290" batchId="meluket-_D7_A9_D7_91_D7_98_meluket__BH_POST_1766518916678_theRebbe_290__p004">
  <section v="9">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section asks for the source of the statement that almost all souls in our generations are called by the name "seed of an animal."</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">3)</t>
    <t s="1">In the maamar there, section 7 at its beginning,</t>
    <t s="2">that almost all the souls in our generations are called by the name "seed of an animal."</t>
    <t s="3">So what is the source for this?</t>
  </section>
  <section v="10">
    <sectionSummaryBrief>This section cites the source in Torah Ohr of the Alter Rebbe and its basis in the Zohar, with additional references.</sectionSummaryBrief>
    <t s="0">So it is in Torah Ohr of the Alter Rebbe</t>
    <t s="1">(author of the Tanya and Shulchan Aruch)</t>
    <t s="2">at the beginning of Parshat Mishpatim.</t>
    <t s="3">And it is based on what is written in the Zohar, Part II, at the beginning of Parshat Mishpatim</t>
    <t s="4">(page 94,</t>
    <t s="5">side b).</t>
    <t s="6">See the Ramaz there.</t>
    <t s="7">And also see Likkutei Torah of our Rebbe (the Alter Rebbe) on Parshat Tzav</t>
    <t s="8">(page 8,</t>
    <t s="9">b and onward).</t>
    <t s="10">Shaarei Teshuvah</t>
    <t s="11">(by his son, the Mitteler Rebbe)</t>
    <t s="12">Part I, discourse beginning "Shishim Hemah."</t>
    <t s="13">And in many places.</t>
  </section>
</awtsmoosMeluketTranslation>
